t: Take the terrible news to Braid the Bloodthirsty at the Central Imperial Camp in Asee-Teph.

Are you a demon-worshipping cultist? A servant of Gorluxor? No?! Then listen - listen well and remember!
I'm the Great Mage Tensess. My soul has remained in Tep's Pyramid for many years, with no way to get out. But with my soul there, I was able to grant the people of Sarnaut my gift.
However, the great Xadaganian mage, Gorluxor, has entered the pyramid. He leads the cultists and his goal is to destroy me for good, to destroy my gift! I'm losing my strength. darkness, disease, and corruption are all around me. This cannot continue for long. They will soon break me!
Most of their operations are in Coba Plateau, which stretches to the east of Tep's Pyramid. That land was desecrated long ago by Tep himself and the power of the Light was not able to break through as it did in other areas.
The only beacons of Light were holy artifacts that were filled with healing powers. Until recently, that is. Now these artifacts belong to the darkness and embody evil and destruction.
If this goes on, the Light itself will turn into darkness! I will vanish and my gift will go with me!
Listen! You hold in your hands the future of this world. Secure a meeting with someone of authority and share everything I told you with them. You must break into the pyramid and stop Gorluxor! Otherwise all will be lost.
What's wrong? Demons again, huh? Cultist schemes? A threat to all living things? Astral smite me! When is this going to end?!
Talk to Nomarkh Userkaf, the supply officer in the Eljune Bazaar.

Oh, I almost forgot! Our supply officer Nomarkh Userkaf has been urgently looking for you. He says he's got important news that's for your ears only. Something concerning an auction.
He's stationed at the Eljune Bazaar. Go visit him and see what's up. It sounded like it was important.

There you are! While you were gone, Profka gathered his mercenaries and together we cornered Plu the Tightwad. Then we managed to squeeze the truth out of him. Apparently his weapons and cloaks were charged with the power of holy artifacts! He said there's plenty of them at Coba Plateau, which lies to the east of Asee-Teph.
These artifacts possessed enormous powers, and they were this close to making the deal of the century. And then something happened which no one expected, least of all Plu the Tightwad. The artifacts lost all their powers!
But it gets worse. The artifacts gained new powers, only this time they were aligned with darkness. The ex-holy cloaks now strangle their wearers, while the blades inflict wounds upon their owners. The power of the Dark Artifacts is growing every day, and everyone's trying to buy them. It's a nightmare!
Talk to Tik the Bawler on the northern edge of the Eljune Bazaar.

Now to get down to business. We need to test these highly-praised weapons before we fork over a lot of gold for them. Fortunately, Plu has agreed to give us a few samples for one of our soldiers to use until we are completely convinced of their power. And that soldier is you.
Head on over to the testing ground just to the north of here. There you will meet up with a goblin named Tik the Bawler who will supply you with the weapons. He's the barker for the auction, so make sure to take what he says with a grain of salt. Some of his sales pitches are really good.

Holy weapons are the next generation of arms! Never has such level of destruction been seen in all of Sarnaut since the Great Cataclysm! Who wins, the League or the Empire? Only the holy weapons can resolve this eternal struggle. And only here and now will you have the unique opportunity to see these wonders in action!
Use the Gar Pheromones on Stoneskin and bring him back to Nomarkh Userkaf.

We've got the auction covered, you bet your boots we do! We'll offer Plu the Tightwad some very valuable technology that's way better than the money the League can come up with. But it won't hurt to find out what else they have up their sleeves...
We've discovered the League's weakest link here in Eljune. It's an Elf, of course - who else could it be? Etienne de Ardeur is technically a scribe, but I have no idea why they keep him on the payroll - he spends all his time at the animal fighting shows.
We Arisen treat machines better than that Elf treats animals. He pits them in the arena, pulling in a bit of dough on the side. He's becoming despised by the Traders lately - his fighting mantis have gone unbeaten for several straight weeks.
Here's my plan. We find a beast that can defeat the Elf's pets and bet enough on the fight that he goes broke. Then we bribe him a little and find out what he knows.
The creature I have in mind is a local gar. He has a shell that no mercenary's axe could scratch. This thing even has a nickname - Stoneskin.
Take these gar pheromones that I managed to buy off the Trader, open the phial under his nose, and then he'll follow you to the edge of the world. Get him to jump in your bag and then come back to this arena!
Whoa, he's a real monster! Didn't take much to lure him in though... Now prepare yourself for defeat, Elf!
Wait for Stoneskin to defeat the Mantis Sentinel and return to Nomarkh Userkaf.

I've placed the bet, and now it's time for our pet to enter the arena. I'm positive he'll tear the Elf's mantis to shreds! Watch carefully, and as soon as we win I can begin to put the pressure on Etienne.
Hold on, let me offer him some gold in exchange for the information.
Talk to Colonel Georgi Batalov at the Kotelny Camp.

I'm afraid I have some bad news. I've just been informed of two things. First, the League has raised a scandal, accusing us of attacking the wagon. Fortunately they have no proof, so let 'em shoot their mouths off all they want.
Secondly, I am told that our scientists were attacked too! The secret blueprints we were going to give to Plu in exchange for the holy weapons were stolen! They say our deserters did this, but that's laughable! This is obviously one of their underhanded tricks. They one-upped us just as we were trying to one-up them!
The auction has been put on hold at the request of both parties. You need to go see Georgi Batalov and tell him about all this as soon as possible. He's the commander of the regiment at the Kotelny Camp. He's got to come up with a plan to rescue those blueprints, 'cause the best idea I've got is to take them back by force.
What do you mean they lost the designs?! We sent an excellent escort with those scientists! Ugh, I should have gone with the wagon myself! What are we going to do now?
Talk to Profka the Fierce at Takalik Harbor.

Plu the Tightwad has just told us his auction has been put on hold. No explanation or anything - simply told us to wait, just like that. He looked really anxious, too...
You know, I'm starting to look at these cunning, hairy Gibberling mugs and think... could the League have gotten to him, twisted his arm? Maybe Plu's secret weapons are being shipped to the League warehouses as we speak?
There's only one way to find out. Traders always talk about the importance of friendship and partnership, but believe me, their words are as hollow as the Astral! They are more than happy to screw one another.
That's what we're going to take advantage of. There's a small port in the northwestern part of Eljune with one of those June names - "Travalik"... "Tasalik"... I don't remember. I'm sure you'll find it.
We know there's a Trader in that port by the name of Profka the Fierce. He's Plu the Tightwad's direct competitor, and he's anxious to crush him. Pay him a visit, 'cause he's on our side in this. We need to know everything - where Plu got the weapons, what he's so scared of, and why the auction's been put on hold.

No! Shut your trap! I don't wanna hear nothing 'bout Plu the Tightwad! One more peep out of you and your brains are flying straight into the Astral! Oh... you're working to sabotage him? Okay, let's talk.
Use the League Uniform, steal the Sack of Gold from the wagon in the Merry Forest, and return to Nomarkh Userkaf.

We might be in a bit of trouble. That Elf told me that the League is very rich! I'm afraid that Plu the Tightwad will see their riches as more attractive than our technology...
If our deal falls through and the League wins those weapons, heads are gonna fly - yours and mine included, make no mistake about that. We're here to make sure the deal goes through whatever the cost - in the name of Yasker and the Empire! No one cares how it gets done, as long as it does! You catching my drift?
Now put your thinking cap on! We've got to put a crimp in League's game! The Elf told me that the wagon carrying their gold is on the road right now - probably somewhere in the Merry Forest. We need to steal it before it gets here, but no one can suspect that it was us!
Hm... The woods are filled with deserters, so it wouldn't come as a surprise if they were robbed by some bum wearing a League uniform. Go put on this outfit on and steal that gold from the League!
Don't forget to change into that uniform. If you attack looking like that and implicate the Empire, I don't know you and you don't know me. This is very important!
Well done! Now the League won't have enough gold, so the weapons are as good as ours!
Kill 6 League Deserters and place Threatening Notes on their bodies, then return to Stone the Merciless.

Some League deserters barged in on the Merry Family's place, the Forest Butterfly! Those jerks! I'll rip 'em some new ones!
I mean, you spend months and months saving up some gold to... to give your girl a nice little present, and then these... these scumbags come and ruin everything. They roughed up the girls real well, and they didn't even pay! Monsters!
We must punish them! We'll teach them a lesson and warn anyone who might think of doing the same. The scum fled into the Merry Forest - find them and rip their guts out.
Oh, and leave a note on each corpse. Here, I scribbled a few. They read - "The first punishment is merciful - death. The second time we cut you so you can't rough up those girls again. - The Free Traders' Mercenaries."
Those poor Butterflies... I bet they can't even remember the last time they did it free of charge. Those men will pay!
Light forbid anyone roughs up our Butterflies again! If they do, I'll deal with them personally!
Collect 6 Imperial Soldiers' Badges from the Imperial deserters and return to Nomarkh Userkaf.

An order came from the Central Imperial Camp in Asee-Teph. More and more soldiers are bolting into the woods, deserting the forces. How stupid can they be? We're on the verge of striking a deal that will ensure the Empire's victory! It will bring eternal glory to everyone who fought under its banners!
I personally would let them go - they'll suffer for their actions in the end and we shouldn't waste time tracking them down. But the leadership wants every faithful servant of the Empire to start killing the deserters. The Imperial Army cannot and will not have traitors, they say.
I think it would help more if we had some quality canned stew for a change, with meat instead of just lard. Maybe they should start providing me funds instead of tossing me crumbs... Ah, never mind. I was ordered to oversee the elimination of the deserters in Eljune, and that's that.
Go out and start killing any deserter you see. Bring me their army badges as proof of their demise. I suspect most of them still have the badges with them, remembering the good old days they left behind.
What's the news on those deserters in the woods? Are there fewer of them now?
Wow! You sure got a lot of badges. I guess there are more deserters out there than I thought.
Eliminate 6 League Deserters or Imperial Deserters in Jakala Ruins. Report back to Nomarkh Userkaf at Eljune Bazaar.

So, shall we continue hunting cowards and traitors? Good. A whole bunch of deserters have set up camp in the ancient Jakala Ruins.
And get this - renegades from both the Empire and the League camp there side by side. Birds of a feather, huh! And to think how much money was spent equipping both. For what? So they could fight each other - not run off into the woods, room together, and lead other soldiers astray too!
We've been given an order to raid their camp and show them what a good traitor is. You guessed it - a dead one. Make sure to kill as many defectors as possible from both sides.
If desertion continue at this pace, who will be left to use these fabulous holy weapons we're trying so hard to purchase?
Let it be a lesson to everyone! Oaths are taken to be honored!
Drink the Windflower Concoction at the Site of Power near Maddox Depot and return to Georgi Batalov.

Here's what I've decided. Near Maddox Depot, the main League camp, there is another Site of Power. You'll have to sneak inside, kill anybody who stands in your way, and then repeat the experiment. Drink the windflower concoction once more and see what happens.
We have to make sure that there really are demonic influences behind this. And if there are, then the northern Site of Power should be contaminated as well. I wonder if the League has any suspicions of their own.
I'm pretty sure they haven't caught on yet. During the Great Astral Campaign, we did almost all the work in eradicating the demons. And I'm sure this time will be the same - inadvertently saving their asses! Oh well, it can't be helped. Now get going.
Did you manage to reach the Site of Power?

What? At the northern Site of Power you were told that world domination was within your grasp? You were filled with hope and determination? How can that be, when we heard warnings of our imminent deaths...
Seize the Secret Imperial Blueprints and return to Colonel Georgi Batalov.

It's obvious - the League stole the designs! What use could those papers be to deserters? If the bums wanted something valuable, they should have stolen a sack of gold like we did! Haha!
I'm afraid you'll have to head right into their base for these papers. The League set up their main camp far to the north, on the other side of the allod. They would definitely hide something as valuable as that in the most secure vault they've got. At least I would if I was in their shoes.
I certainly don't envy your task - I don't need to tell you that there will be a lot of League soldiers there. But this is of the utmost important to the entire Empire! I trust you will bring those documents back immediately, soldier.
I'm an old war dog but I've never seen anyone having to risk their life for a couple of pieces of paper. The world is certainly changing fast.
You did it! C'mon, let me see what the fuss was all about! Classified? Oh, sure, I understand...
Steal 6 Kegs of Kanian Beer and bring them to Inna Ipatieva.

And now for the main feature - refreshments! I hate to admit this, especially being the morale officer, but the best beer is brewed in Kania. So I've thought of a little stunt that can get us some.
Basically, you need to sneak into the League camp on the northern coast and pinch eight kegs of Kanian beer from right under their noses. I'm sure they'll defend it pretty fiercely - it is delicious, after all - but Batalov's party needs to be the best!
Just think how excited the guys will be when they see those kegs. They haven't had some good brew in ages. This is gonna be the greatest bash ever! Tonight we will celebrate for hours!
It's been a while since I poured some Kanian beer down my throat! I can't wait!

Everything is ready for the celebration! Batalov will be happy and the guys will have tons of fun. It will be a tiny bit of joy in this impenetrable darkness. What? You still want to take care of inviting the girls? Thanks, but we already made an arrangement with the Forest Butterfly.
Deliver the Secret Imperial Blueprints to Nomarkh Userkaf.

Hurry up and deliver these blueprints to Nomarkh Userkaf. I don't want them to remain in the camp another day. All these scribbles bring is trouble.
Make sure you don't drop them along the way. And make sure not to peek at them! Who knows what those Arisen would do to you if you found out their secrets. Never trust those scientists... damn pencil-pushers with gears for brains!
C'mon, make my day - I need some good news! Have you found the blueprints?
Excellent! Now we can pay for the weapons! The bad thing is, we aren't gonna see those devices yet, and neither is the League!
Kill 6 League Centurions and return to Colonel Georgi Batalov.

We're about to win the battle against the League outpost to the north. We recently lost a few strategic positions, but I know we're about to win them back. You see, the League has been putting up a weaker fight lately. It's almost as if they're preoccupied. Now that they've let their guard down, we're sure to win.
But we need to make one final push to make sure. That's why I'm sending all available forces there immediately. That includes you.
Make sure to watch out for any nasty surprises. And don't underestimate the League soldiers either - they've recently sent in more seasoned troops, so they'll put up quite a fight!
Right now we need all the help we can get up there.
There was a positive mention of you in the last report I got from the commanders near the League outpost. I'll think about nominating for a reward. Good job!
Talk to Nomarkh Sekhmet near Zoloi Outpost.

We managed to capture a very strategic point near Zoloi Outpost. It has a high elevation, and I just know that the League is going to try and win it back.
Nomarkh Sekhmet is in charge of our detachment there. What an incredible woman! They say her feelings for Yasker go way beyond patriotic. Of course, they're not quite in the same league...
That's why Sekhmet keeps herself busy chopping heads left and right, either in rage or in hope... She is absolutely fearless, and her name is surrounded with so many gory legends that it alone makes the League militia tremble!
You need to report to her and see if she needs any help. I kind of envy you, for I'm sure you're going to see a pretty intense battle.

Hmm, do you come from Batalov? For some reason, reinforcements always come right after we've lost a battle. Well, raise your head and look me in the eyes. Are you thirsty for enemy blood? Yeah, I can see you are! Welcome to my squad!
Use the Astral Charger on 6 Landmines, kill 10 League Sappers, and return to Nomarkh Sekhmet.

The League is preparing a counter-offensive. Well, we're ready to entertain our dear guests. We set up some landmines outside the base, but they need to be activated first. Take this Astral charger and use it on the mines so they'll go off when I cast the activation spell. That's order number one.
The second one is - make sure the League doesn't send sappers to defuse our mines. That would ruin our entire plan, and we can't be having that. If you see the bastards, kill them immediately.
The mines should be set up on some bright green grass at the foot of the hill. Remember it well, because soon it will all be dark red... with blood. Long live Yasker!
Let the League soldiers try and come near. First they'll lose their legs, and when they finally manage to crawl to the top of the hill, off come their heads!
Great job! Now there's no way they can defeat us! Glory to Yasker!
Talk with Stoneroot to the west of the Kotelny Camp.

Many animals have recently been leaving their homes to the west for no apparent reason. But I think I know what's behind this. They can sense the demons, and they're getting out before it gets worse. I've seen this happen many times before - more than I would like.
I know their instincts are sharper than ours, and I can just see the panic and terror in their eyes. It's a shame they can't tell us anything. But there may be one way to find out what they know...
Some soldiers saw a treant in the forest who's recently migrated here from the west as well. He might be able to tell us his story and let us know what's going on. Go ask him what he knows, and the sooner the better. We need to find out what's happening.

Go your own way, move along. You're about to get stuck in my branches. Oh, do you want to talk with me? Okay... go ahead, but don't speak too fast. And I must warn you that I just came here from the west, so I can't give you directions.
Gather 6 Windflower Leaves in the woods around the Imperial Camp and bring them to Colonel Georgi Batalov.

I have my own reasons to believe that demons are near. It's the dreams! Yes! You see, the whole camp is afflicted with nightmares.
In my dreams, I am taken captive by the League. My tormentors heat up their tongs and start torturing me, and I... I give away a war secret. Me, an old soldier with medals for distinguished service! I hate these nightmares. I wake up in a cold sweat, feeling like I was tortured for real.
Apparently the other soldiers have been having nightmares, too. At night they refuse to go to bed, playing cards until they can't see straight or pilfering energy pills from the healer's supply. The last time I saw something like this happen, demons appeared shortly afterwards.
But I know a way to stop this. Unfortunately, it's not easy. You must face your fear and overcome it. I want to try it... The healer and I decided that I should do it in my dreams. I will need six windflower leaves to fall into a deep sleep. Can you gather them for me in the forest?

I'm sick and tired of these nightmares. Everyone dreams of whatever they fear the most - getting a leg cut off, their spouse cheating on them... It all looks so clear and vivid that you wake up with only one desire - to strangle yourself.
The windflower leaves, they're here! But I'm afraid I won't be the one drinking the infusion. Something's come up.
Collect 6 Cursed Shards and bring them to Stoneroot.

No, the treants will not help you. You're allied with those who brought the evil and damned our people! What? You deny it? Well I don't believe you! So we have nothing to talk about.
I suppose if you brought proof of your innocence, I might reconsider. But how do you propose to do that, shorty? I can think of very few deeds that would earn my trust.
Hm. Well, on the shore there are many evil will-o'-the-wisps that emanate dark energy. They started appearing when the corrupters did, so if you destroy them you must not be their friends. Bring me a few fragments from their bodies, and then we'll talk.
If you're in league with the demon bringers, then you won't kill the damned will-o'-the-wisps.
Here they are, the cursed shards. Okay, I'll believe you shorty.
Pass the treant's words to Colonel Georgi Batalov.

Now listen to my sorrowful tale. Terrible beasts came to our lands and they spread a plague, making flowers wither and trees droop. Treants and even unicorns fell asleep, never to awaken. We were too slow to act, and only a few of us managed to escape...
But before that, before night descended on us, the will-o'-the-wisps appeared. The treants were happy to see them, thinking they would be a nice decoration for our woods... but they turned out to be harbingers of darkness! They were cursed! We hate them so. We hate darkness so!
Your forest is so crummy, so pitiful. We miss our beautiful woods, oh we do! But we cannot return, not while that dark aura remains. It would devour us all within days. Go tell your brethren this, and warn them not to go to the west.

Did you talk to the treants? They don't usually welcome other creatures, making themselves out to possess the great wisdom of the ages and all that. But now that the whole world is going crazy, maybe they'll ease up a little!
So, there's a great darkness to the west. My gut tells me that demon worshippers are behind all this. I pray to the Light I'm wrong! But my intuition has never failed me, otherwise I would have never survived the Great Astral Campaign.
Drink the Windflower Concoction at the Site of Power near the Kotelny Camp and return to Colonel Batalov.

Here's what happened. There's a Site of Power not far from the camp, and it was guarded by our very best soldiers. And then bam! One of them lost his marbles. He attacked and killed a few of his comrades, so we unfortunately had to neutralize him.
Witnesses say he went mad while he was asleep. He did his best to stay awake through the night, but he ended up dozing off at his post. I heard that Sites of Power attract demons, so they must be the ones behind this.
There's been a change of plans. Now you will drink the windflower concoction at the same place that poor boy fell asleep. I'll have some soldiers watching you from afar in case anything happens. We must find if anyone else who dozes off near the Site of Power will become cursed.
Perhaps the soldier was just exhausted from many sleepless nights. I pray to the Light that demons have not infected the Site of Power!
What? Your dream urged you to kill and started to drive you crazy? That's different from the normal ones the soldiers' have been having. This is more serious than I thought.
Obtain 6 pieces of Tender Bear Meat for Inna Ipatieva at Kotelny Camp.

Psst... Come closer and keep quiet. Colonel Batalov's birthday is coming up soon. Of course, no one remembered about it and the situation isn't exactly festive. However, I'm in charge of morale around here and I think a little relaxation is just what the soldiers need right now. In other words, a party.
Barbecue, beer, gals... you know the deal. Batalov would flip a lid if he learned about the preparations, so we've got to keep it hush-hush. Then, when it's all ready, I bet he won't refuse a bite of barbecued meat with some brewsky. He'll come around, you'll see!
Since you're new here and not well known around the camp, you'll make a perfect conspirator. The colonel deserves a pleasant surprise, so let's make it happen! For starters, I suggest hunting some bears. Their meat while taste great after it's been on the grill for a bit.

Boy did we throw a feast last year! But that time we had unicorn chops and even stuffed ravens. We can't get any of that now - it's gotten too dangerous to wander far from the camp. We'll just have to make do with bear meat.
The meat looks delicious! Literally mouth-watering. But we still need some seasoning.
Check the Chapel of Tensess at Zoloi Outpost and the Holy Spring in the Tipsy Thicket.

So evil will-o'-the-wisps are giving off dark energy, like the ones near the Sites of Power. Hm, that's so weird. They have never been the forerunners of demons. But if the treant said so... he couldn't lie! A treant is hard to get chatting, but if he does speak, he won't waste time on lies.
So, will-o'-the-wisps. Let's find out where else in the forest they have been gathering, besides the Sites. We should check the Chapel of Tensess at the League outpost to the north and the Holy Spring in the Tipsy Thicket.
I hope I'm wrong and they aren't there, but I'm getting this sinking feeling... If they were drawn to the other sources of holy energy, then they might be drawn to those too.
I thought that the will-o'-the-wisps came here from the west like other creatures, fleeing in terror. It seems the real story is quite different...
That means the Chapel and the Spring are contaminated! Nezeb save us all!
Collect some Thick Branches, camouflage yourself, and then kill 6 League Snipers before returning to Georgi Batalov.

The demons might be a big issue, but we can't forget about our immediate problems. Eight League snipers have hidden themselves somewhere in the thickets to the north of here. They're sharpshooters hand- picked by Aidenus himself, sent here all the way from the Kanian capital.
They can hit a fly from three hundred yards away. A real fly, wings flapping and all. And each one has taken out at least ten of our boys... if not more. But we can't just barge in on them, - we gotta play it smart.
Here's the plan. Find some branches from the bushes around the northern camp and camouflage yourself with them. Then sneak up on the snipers. That's the only way you can find one before he picks you off like a drowsy winter fly. Are we clear?
At least the snipers hid in the thickets and not in the trees. They'd make mincemeat of us in a hurry if they did. I hope you can put them in their place.
The notorious snipers have finally fallen, as I knew they would. We have won, and now their legend is at an end.
Kill 6 League Invaders and the Robust Family and return to Georgi Batalov.

We've got a little problem to the north of here.
A League squad seized a large cave and managed to hole themselves up pretty well. The enemy goes on daring raids against us and then hides behind rock walls again. Resembles an animal's tactic, but that's not surprising - they're led by three Gibberling wenches! Can you tell I'm fuming?! I told them a thousand times - keep your eyes on that cave! And now we're paying for our mistakes!
Try to get into that cave and kill whoever you can. If we can weaken their forces, we should be able to finish them out with an all-out assault. Just make sure you take out their furry lady captains!
Are the League soldiers still in that cave? Do they continue to raid our men?
Great! Let them try and come near our territory again!
Bring 6 Jatra Leaves to Inna Ipatieva.

Last year we decorated the tables by gathering some carnivorous plants and putting them in flower bowls. When they opened their mouths, we would throw bones inside. It was lots of fun.
It's a shame that this time everything's secret and done in a hurry. Oh well... We shall just do the best we can. Hm, go get me some leaves from the jatra bushes that grow around here. That should be simple enough! Then we can turn the ordinary bear meat into an exquisite dish. You can find most of the plants in the woods to the northwest. Mm... I just love the taste of those leaves. They're so spicy! I'm looking forward to your return.

When we were stationed in the east, our cook was as happy as a clam. You walk into the jungle and see spices all around you - growing under your feet, hanging off of trees, falling from the sky! This region here, it's got nothing but the little jatra bushes. But they're better than nothing I guess.
Ah, there they are! The cook already knows about our little plans. I need to give him these leaves immediately!
Plant 6 League Arrows into the bodies of Majestic Eagles and return to Vadim Shnygin.

Don't kill me! Yes, I abandoned my post, and now I live in the thicket with these forest nuts... but I have realized what a fool I was! I'm a traitor, and I know I deserve death. But please, let me make amends. I feel I am responsible for... doing something good for my country.
I've been hiding here for a while, hoping to meet one of my people. Fate sent you to me, thank Nezeb! One Kanian deserter told me the League was planning to gang up with forestfolk. They are a feeble, cowardly people, but they know every twig, stump, and tree-hole in the forest. The League plans to use this information to launch an attack on the main Imperial camps!
But that's not all! I've thought of a way to spoil their scheme. Walking through the woods I picked up a few arrows left by the League archers. Now, the forest is full of eagles which the forestfolk consider holy. If we kill a few of these birds and stick the enemy's arrows in their dead bodies, the forestfolk will never forgive the League for such treachery. Do you think you can carry out my plan?

I wouldn't say life in the barracks was bad. But I really got sick of the friggin' war! Sleeping in your uniform, taking leaks on the march, barely any access to womanly comfort, and knowing every day could be your last...
I couldn't take it, I had to feel freedom once more. But I curse the day I left! I'm glad I thought of one more way to help my country. Now I can die with a clean conscience if that is my fate!
Great job! The League and the forestfolk are now enemies for good. Could you, umm... maybe put in a word for me with the commanders? Thanks so much!
Participate in killing Yaver Merenptah and return to Stone the Merciless.

Remember how I told you we hired a fellow to get rid of the nasty wildlife? And then he proved to be completely useless and wound up dead in a drunken brawl? His injuries were so bad we thought he'd never be able to resurrect, but it appears that the story of our incompetent necromancer continues.
Someone spotted him in the woods, completely drunk and summoning more minions! Apparently, necromancers are not only adept at resurrecting the dead, but themselves too! Go figure! I suppose he's mad about the way he was treated by the Free Traders, so now he's trying to kill them.
His name is Yaver Merenptah, and now there's a bounty on his head. We're not about to wait for him to finish summoning his little army before we strike. Grab your weapons and a few good companions and head into the Tipsy Thicket if you want to claim the reward.
We should have a rule about giving alcohol to crazy people around here...
Finally, now that incompetent moron is dead once again. And may he stay dead this time! Now here's your reward.
Kill the Demonic Shadow and return to Sarbaz Sahure.

All of my plans for making it big in the Holy Land could be ruined by one little thing you know. Just one! That's all it takes. And that is why I always consider every component of a situation. Then such a thing will never happen!
At the moment I am worried about that shadow over there. It is a very odd creature, the likes of which I have never seen myself. I have heard about them of course - there are many rumors among the Arisen that Tep controls a whole army of them. But to see one in person... and here...
I'm sure that it's somehow connected to the attack on the outpost, but what I don't know is how it will continue to affect my business! So far it hasn't attacked anyone, but what if it was to go berserk? It could kill the pilgrims, or the people I hired to collect the tree sap!
I need to get rid of this unknown variable. It's worrying me too much! Do you think you could kill it and remove the creature from the equation? Make sure to bring some reliable comrades with you - it looks like it can handle itself.
Being a merchant can be quite complicated. We have to deal with all types of things, even incomprehensible creatures like shadows!
Excellent! Now I'll have some crazy profits, I'm sure of it! Here, take this reward for your trouble.
Use the Silver Amulet on Matvei Volkov and defeat Bloodmaw before returning to Peter Iliev.

I can feel the darkness! Right here in this sanctuary! Oh, if only Zosim were here. He would immediately cleanse this evil!
Who could be the source of this dark energy? I have a guess, but I cannot be certain. His name is Matvei Volkov and he's a pilgrim that recently arrived. He's unsociable and strange. I could have sworn I heard him growl sometimes, and he vaguely smells of blood.
We must find out his true identity immediately. Take this silver amulet. If he is a werewolf, then when you touch him with it he will be forced to show his true form. Then you must defeat the evil creature! And if he is not a monster, then I suppose I shall apologize to him later.
One more thing - do not go to him alone. If he truly is a werewolf he must be a very powerful one to maintain that disguise for so long. Gather a group of friends and then use the power of the amulet.
Oh, what if I am wrong and I am simply making false accusations. Zosim, why aren't you here?
So what I feared was true! To think that such darkness was right in the heart of this sanctuary. Thank you so much for your help!
Find a captain at the Takalik Harbor who will venture to the Edge of Eternal Night.

I shudder to even think about this... But we have no choice.
There's a third Site of Power in what the soldiers have dubbed the "Edge of Eternal Night." It's situated in the westernmost part of Eljune. That's where all the animals are fleeing from. I don't dare imagine what is going on there! No, I cannot send you there, I just can't! I won't let the darkness into your soul!
Let's do this instead. Take this gold - it's everything that was in the coffers of our parish, but we can't afford not to spend it on something as important as this... Go to Takalik Harbor and find some desperado... some reckless hoodlum that will take the money and explore the Edge of Eternal Night. The Site of Power is right on the shore.
I pray that Light shines bright on the path of this bold spirit! Go to the port now and find a suitable man!

So you want us to go to the Edge of Eternal Night? No animals ever go near that place. Well, we're not dumb like animals, and we've been to places you couldn't even imagine, baby! But it's gonna cost you. Let me see that purse again... hmm...

Alright, I'll do it! After all, sailing to the Edge of Eternal Night ain't the same as supplying the Empire with ammunition while under fire from the League's ships. We've got a deal! We'll come back soon and let you know what happened.
Return to Maria Trepetova at Maddox Depot.

If only we had known!
A dozen purses like yours would have never budged us or our boat! Do you even know what's going on there? The shore is occupied by cultists and the Astral is teeming with demons! And that's just what we had time to see. We were there for about two minutes before we turned our ship around and hauled ass out of there! Our official advice is to stay far, far away from that cursed coast! We're not going back either, no way.
In fact, we're pulling anchor right now and going home, never to set foot in the Holy Land again! Sacred my butt. It sure looks cursed to us!
Have you found a single daring captain who would sacrifice himself for the cause of the Light? I hope he found a peaceful shore!
Find a passage from June Itsmal to Tipsy Thicket, then kill 4 Imperial Protectors. Report back to Vasily Shabunin.

Psst! C'mere! I saw you in the League Camp, so I know I can trust you. I only look like a pilgrim, but I'm actually working for the League Army - but keep that just between you and me.
I'm supposed to be travelling with everyone else to pay homage to the Great Ascetic, but my real purpose is very different - I'm trying to find a direct route from here to Tipsy Thicket so we can move closer to the Imperial camp.
The only problem is, my fellow travelers are getting suspicious about my frequent disappearances, especially the ones during the night. I can't afford to leave the camp any more.
There's even one Imperial citizen in my group! My mission is on the verge of failure. I'm so lucky to have run into you, I know you can help!
Please explore this area and see if there's a passage from here to Tipsy Thicket. It's probably guarded by Imperial soldiers, so you may have to fight some... but this is all for the sake of the League, for our victory!
There's got to be a passage from here to Tipsy Thicket!
Well done! Those Imperial dogs are going to piss their pants when we sneak up from behind!
Find the Great Ascetic Zosim Nikulin in the western part of the Zosim Coast.

There's only one person who can help us now. Or is there! Is he still human? I don't know... He may be a saint by now...
The Great Ascetic lives on the Zosim Coast.
It's hard for me to even talk about him, because words are just... too crude to describe him. His picture cannot be painted with language - perhaps only the first, gentle rays of sunlight could do it justice. He is purity, he is lucidity, and he is the Light itself! Pilgrims know this full well - that is why they gravitate to his place of meditation from every corner of Sarnaut.
But I've got to tell you this... He was an exalted warrior in the Great Astral Campaign - he has looked into the eyes of the darkness and its disciples. No one knows more about them than his pure heart. We must come to him for advice, and he will save us. He is the Light itself! You will soon see for yourself!
I can see through hills and forests...

You seek information about the Edge of Eternal Night? Once, a long time ago, a June temple stood there that was called the Temple of Endless Night. No traces of it exist anymore - the earth cracked and the temple slipped into the Astral. But in its place emerged a Site of Power, the most powerful one in the Holy Land.
Since then it has been contaminated by demon worshippers. Now the place is full of darkness. They say something similar has happened in Asee-Teph, but the destruction here is much more serious.
The demonic disciples have amassed great strength, and they sow more evil every day. There is only one way that I can think of that will defeat them. But it is a very difficult feat...
Speak with Stanislav Kubarev along the Zosim Coast.

The Great Ascetic isn't here. He's gone... Do you see that woman over there? It's all because of her! If not for my orders I would just...
The ignoble Empire accused us of employing demonic Gibberlings to brainwash the Imperial soldiers. What kind of nonsense is that? We, the League, using demonic forces - why, that's preposterous!
We thought about who could serve as our judge. It had to be someone both the League and the Empire revered... the Great Ascetic! He is a saint, after all.
I came here to present the Ascetic with our key piece of evidence - the Gibberlings themselves. He would see at once that there wasn't a demonic trace anywhere on them.
They are merely regular Gibberlings - the furry, tender creatures we all know and love! How could such a foul thought cross anyone's mind?!
Then this Imperial lady pops up with her absurd, far-fetched accusations. The Ascetic listened to us for a while, then got up and shut the doors in our faces! Of course, it was all her clamoring and wailing that drove him mad!
I don't know where the Ascetic went or when he will return... but there is another pressing concern. The Gibberling seers are scheduled to arrive on the coast soon, but there's a savage battle taking place near there.
The Empire is attempting to eliminate our forces while waiting for Yasker's emissary to arrive. She allegedly has documents that prove the demonic nature of our Gibberlings. Go to Stanislav Kubarev on the Zosim Coast and offer your assistance. Now run to the shore, quickly!
Speak quickly, I haven't a moment to spare! Did you come from Amvonov? Right on time! The enemy is pressing us hard!
Kill 6 Imperial Soldiers on the Zosim Coast. Report to Stanislav Kubarev.

The prophets will be here any minute, and the Empire has already set up an encampment on the opposite side of the shore. I'm sure their intentions are most sinister, naturally - as best befits the Empire.
We have no choice but strike first.
I order you to go kill the Imperial Army soldiers! The only good Imperial soldier is a dead Imperial soldier!
The Imperial forces have been knocked out? Excellent!
Stop 6 Imperial Shamans from performing their ritual on the Astral shore outside of the Imperial Camp for Stanislav Kubarev.

The Empire wants to pull a fast one on us! Our scouts tell us of shamans near their encampment that are performing a heathen ritual. They're trying to summon a tornado that will destroy our ship before it even reaches the shore!
Those monsters have already begun their black magic ritual. We must stop them before something irreparable happens!
All our efforts will be in vain if the tornado destroys the ship. We need to stop the shamans!
The shamans are dead? Well done!
Kill Major Sarang Monte and report back to Stanislav Kubarev.

This is going nowhere! We kill the Imperial soldiers and they just come right back! We must make sure that they stay dead. No more fooling around, you must decapitate the enemy! The Imperial forces are led by Major Sarang Monte, who has been recently resurrected.
Send him back to the grave where he belongs!

Without their major, the Imperial troops will turn into a herd of disoriented sheep.
Not that they don't already resemble a herd as it is...
The major is dead? What a smooth execution! I could hear his death cry from here!
Meet with and defend the disembarked League Seers.

Light help us!
The seers have landed! Why didn't anyone warn me?! Damnit, think about how much better it would be without our trademark Kanian laziness! I can't do anything with these soldiers!
Get to the shore right away. The Empire will no doubt try to kill them and prevent us from refuting their lies.
Greet the little ones and defend them from the enemy's attack!

Whoa! We certainly didn't expect a welcome this warm...
You showed up early! We only just began to go into our trance. Would have shown those Imperial scum who rules the Holy Land!
Excellent! We finally made it to the Holy Land!
Take the news of the victory to Miroslav Amvonov.

It's like I've always said, "all's well that ends well."
The seers are safe in the camp and the Empire got the short end of the stick. Take this great bit of news to the priest. I'm sure he'll bestow some sort of reward upon you.

The Gibberlings are here! Light shines upon our path!
Let that wench run her mouth as much as she likes... Our proof will be certain. As soon as Zosim sees the Gibberlings...
By the way, Zosim... They haven't seen him yet, have they? That's okay, we'll wait for his return.
We are deeply grateful for your valorous service on behalf of the Church of Light!
Use the Amulet of True Faith to purify the Site of Power at the Edge of Eternal Night and inform Maria Trepetova of your deeds.

Faith! Your faith is capable of saving a unicorn, maybe it will also be capable of saving all of Eljune.
Do you believe that it's possible? Now that the Amulet is filled with your faith, it can purify the Cursed Site of Power in the Edge of Eternal Night. But to reach it, you will need more than just faith! You'll also need strong arms, quick feet, and a sharp mind. The Edge of Eternal Night is devoid of any living soul or innocent animal. No one knows for certain what awaits you there...
I wish to go with you... My spirit reaches out, but my legs won't obey. All I can do is give you my blessing. Now go!
There you are! Got any news? I pray that it's good!

Eljune has been purified!
So that's what it was! I had no idea of how much power you were capable of. Remember, when I asked you to sprinkle the barracks with holy water? Who would have guessed that you would be our salvation.
I will be forever proud that fate brought me into contact with you. I pray that the Light does not forsake you in all your future endeavors!
Kill Kilza the Shadowy and take his heart to Mikhail Selyaninov at Maddox Depot.

There's one demon that rules the other monsters that inhabit the Edge of Eternal Night. He is called Kilza the Shadowy, and judging from his dark fruits of his labor, his power is a hundred times greater. You need to face this demon, and rip his heart right out of his chest! That should slow down their activities.
What will happen to the world if Astral demons spread across all the allods? They would exterminate everyone else - the furry Gibberlings, the beautiful Elves, the intelligent Arisen, the freedom-loving Orcs...
We cannot let that happen! We must slow the demons' activities and then discover their plans. Once you kill Kilza the Shadowy, take his heart to Mikhail Selyaninov. He's an old war dog and he'll know what it means.
What happened? I've been extremely restless ever since you left.

A demon heart... This is scary news. Demons are a formidable enemy. I learned that first-hand during the Great Astral Campaign. We thought we were victorious, but it seems the celebration was premature. I must send a report to Aidenus at once. If our victory was not conclusive, we must act immediately!
Take the terrible news to Esther de Desirae, the archmage of the League Defenders in the Central League Camp in Asee-Teph.

Are you a demon-worshipping cultist? A servant of Gorluxor? No?! Then listen - listen well and remember!
I'm the Great Mage Tensess. My soul has remained in Tep's Pyramid for many years, with no way to get out. But with my soul there, I was able to grant the people of Sarnaut my gift.
However, the great Xadaganian mage, Gorluxor, has entered the pyramid. He leads the cultists and his goal is to destroy me for good, to destroy my gift! I'm losing my strength. darkness, disease, and corruption are all around me. This cannot continue for long. They will soon break me!
Most of their operations are in Coba Plateau, which stretches to the east of Tep's Pyramid. That land was desecrated long ago by Tep himself and the power of the Light was not able to break through as it did in other areas.
The only beacons of Light were holy artifacts that were filled with healing powers. Until recently, that is. Now these artifacts belong to the darkness and embody evil and destruction.
If this goes on, the Light itself will turn into darkness! I will vanish and my gift will go with me!
Listen! You hold in your hands the future of this world. Secure a meeting with someone of authority and share everything I told you with them. You must break into the pyramid and stop Gorluxor! Otherwise all will be lost.
Not again! It's the demons, isn't it? Why do I always have to clean up these messes?!
Speak with the Peppy Family in the Eljune Bazaar.

I've got some news for you. The Peppy Family is looking for you. It has something to do with an auction... They asked me to tell you that they need you right away.
You better get off your ass and go speak with them. It could be important.

Ah, there you are! Profka and his mercenaries teamed up with us and together we nailed Plu the Tightwad to the wall - the wall of his warehouse where he kept the holy weapons hidden.
It turns out the holy weapons were imbued with magical artifacts that the goblins were collecting at Coba Plateau. They kept this secret from everyone and were this close to making the deal of the century. And then something happened that no one could have expected... The artifacts lost all their powers!
But that's not all, the artifacts started gaining new powers, powers that were aligned with darkness!
The ex-holy cloaks now strangle their wearers while the blades inflict wounds on their masters. The powers from the dark artifacts are growing every day along with their demand. All sorts of adventure seekers, including pirates and deserters, are flooding the Plateau.
This allod is in a state of havoc, and the world has gone completely nuts! Everyone is after easy pickings and too few care about the fact that the Light is forsaking the allod and darkness is taking its place...
Talk to Tik the Bawler on the northern edge of the Eljune Bazaar.

The auction is going to be starting soon and all we've heard about the holy weapons is the seller's pitch.
Traders are crooks by their very nature... We need to hold the weapons in our hands, try them out for ourselves.
Go to the testing ground and find Tik Bawler there. He's a part-time barker, part-time consultant... and full-time loudmouth! Keep your wits about you when you talk to him!

Holy weapons are the next generation of arms! Never has such level of destruction been seen in all of Sarnaut since the Great Cataclysm! Who wins, the League or the Empire? Only the holy weapons can resolve this eternal struggle. And only here and now will you have the unique opportunity to see these wonders in action!
Find the Stash of Sea Salt for the Peppy Family.

The League must win the auction! We've already collected an enormous sum! We should still keep an eye on the Empire though... I'd love to find out how much gold they've brought!
We're thinking of getting close to their treasury through the Ensign Yaver Tao. He's an addict and the Empire is up to their necks in hallucinogenic psi-salt. It's completely banned here, but when did bans ever stop the dealers? The salt is everywhere! What has Sarnaut come to?
I heard that the dealers have a barrel in the forest - the largest barrel of psi-salt in Eljune! When we become the only ones in the entire camp with access to the salt... Ta-da! Yaver Tao will sell anything or anyone for a hit - his father, his mother, Yasker, or the entire Imperial treasury!
Light forbid you try the sea salt!
The salt! Well done! Now we've got this Arisen - hook, line, and sinker.
Watch what happens and speak with the Peppy Family afterwards.
There goes Yaver Tao! He hasn't had salt for more than a day. Just you wait and you'll witness a horrifying, but instructive, scene.
Ew... Addicts! What a sore sight!
As you can see, our plan worked! A little interrogation and the Empire is in the palm of our hand.
Talk to Mikhail Selyaninov at Maddox Depot.

What am I going to do? Everyone knows the designs are missing, but no one believes that the deserters did it despite your efforts and disguises... That isn't the biggest problem though...
The League's wagon train has been robbed! A bag of gold was stolen! I'm sure you won't be surprised to learn who did it - deserters from the League Army!
Heh... we're not falling for that one! It doesn't take three brilliant heads like ours to know that the Empire is behind this. Now that both bidders are out of their respective bargaining chips, the auction has been put on hold.
So, here's what you need to do. Go to Maddox Depot in the north and report to Commander Mikhail Selyaninov. We need to figure out how to snatch our gold back from the Empire's clutches. Things have gotten pretty complicated, haven't they? I wonder what's going to happen now.

What? What gold are you talking about?! What am I supposed to do about missing gold? I sent an entire group of guards with the wagon! If they let it slip through their fingers, I'll hang them on the first tree I see! Now stop bothering me with minor issues! We've got more serious problems, like the satyrs!
Talk to Profka the Fierce at Takalik Harbor.

We've got a problem. Plu the Tightwad declined to start the bidding! He says the auction has been put on hold indefinitely. That isn't fair! But then again, I guess we shouldn't expect fairness from a goblin seller and a resurrected Zem buyer. Still, we're outraged! We're convinced that the Empire bought Plu out! Yeah! For all we know, the holy weapons could already be in boxes at the Imperial warehouses.
There's a small trade port in the northwest portion of Eljune, it's got one of those June names - Takalik Harbor. We know there's an honest Orc Trader there by the name of Profka the Fierce.
He and Plu hate each other... How can you be fellow members of the same club and not cooperate or respect each other?! I don't get that. I mean, isn't life a lot easier when you're surrounded by friends and not alone? Am I right? Stupid Traders!
Anyway, Profka might be able to help us, so go talk to him. I'm sure he knows a lot of interesting details. Like, where does a goblin get this kind of goods? And the most important thing - why was the auction put on hold?!

No! Shut your trap! I don't wanna hear nothing 'bout no Plu the Tightwad! One more peep out of you about it and your brains are flying straight into the Astral!
Oh... You're working to sabotage him? Okay, let's talk.
Find 3 League Deserters in the Merry Forest and tell them about the Amnesty Order. Report back to the Peppy Family.

Good news from Novograd!
There are many deserters in the nearby woods, but not all of them are cowards or traitors. Soldiers get tired in long, drawn out wars like this one. What's so good about running wild in the woods, turning to the life of a bandit? Shouldn't he finish his tour of service and come back to his family?
This horrible war is the problem! It makes everyone's lives miserable. But leadership is finally coming around. An amnesty decree has been issued. Many deserters are now realizing that they were wrong and are sorry. And we're sure that there are lots of them! Please take this copy of the amnesty decree and read it to any League deserters you run into while in the forest. Let them rejoin the forces!

We heard that deserters attacked the brothel. What is this world coming to?
Intelligent beings are becoming more and more like wild animals. I'm so glad we finally got that amnesty decree.

Wow, that's great! We're so happy to hear this wonderful news!
Just imagine how excited these soldiers' mothers and wives will be. These guys have become true League Defenders again. They will come home as heroes and will finally be able to kiss and hug their loves ones! Thank you.
Kill 6 Imperial Deserters, place Threatening Notes on their bodies, and return to Stone the Merciless.

We've got a real mess here! Last night the Watering Hole got looted by Imperial deserters. What's the Watering Hole? Why, that's the best place in Eljune to quench your thirst! Well, the only, but still the best. Hehe.
Those Imperial jerks snatched up all the vodka they could carry and ran off with it. I hope they die a thirsty death!
Go deal with them. You'll find them easily... I bet they still reek of booze. And to make it a lesson for all the others, leave this note on each body: "A real scumbag. Died from drowning in stolen vodka. - The Free Traders' Mercenaries." Deal?

I swear - not another swig from the bottle until I find and kill every last bastard that looted The Watering Hole.
Well, maybe just one little brewsky...
The deserters are dead? Serves them right! Maybe they'll think twice about stealing our booze next time!
Put on the cap with the Empire's insignia and attack the colony of scientists in Tipsy Thicket. Seize the Empire's secret technology and report back to the Peppy Family.

Yaver Tao swears that the Empire isn't carrying gold. They want to pay using the secret technology. What does that mean for us? It means the goblins might decide that it's a better acquisition!
This is no good... We've never gone down the slippery slope of intrigue... But we just can't let the Empire win that auction or, perish the thought, the war as well! It would be the end of Sarnaut and all that is good and right! Just look at that Yaver Tao!
Imperial scientists are transporting the secret plans... What if we could capture them in Tipsy Thicket? That would kill two birds with one stone - we'll cut the Empire out of the auction and get our hands on the enemy's technology! It'll be a legendary operation! You'll have a fight on your hands - the scientists will most definitely have security, and they might have one or two experienced sorcerers. But we believe in you!
The most important thing is that nobody can suspect the League. Absolutely not! During the operation, wear the cap of an Empire defector. Let them suspect that scum.
Just don't forget to put on your cap on for the attack. Light forbid that anybody suspects us!

The plans! Let's see if they're really worth all that gold!
Do you understand anything? We don't either! That's why we're out here in the middle of nowhere instead of back in the capital, in a nice scientist's office, with a leather chair big enough for three Gibberlings! Well, whatever! That's not what matters. The Empire's out of luck. The holy weapons will be ours!
Kill 6 Imperial Defectors and hang 3 copies of the Amnesty Order on the trees around the Jakala Ruins for the Peppy Family.

We have to keep working to bring the deserters back into our forces.
Rumor has it that the deserters have collected at the Jakala Ruins, the ancient June ruins to the west of Merry Forest. Traitors to the League and the Empire are gathered there together. Just imagine the horror! We've got to get our guys out! The League is planning an offensive and we need the warriors!
Please hang copies of the order on the trees around the deserters' camp. Obviously, the Empire traitors will try to stop you but don't mince words with them. Our guys probably won't be pleased either, but they're just lost souls. They'll need time to read the order and change their minds... And we definitely hope that happens soon!

We can't sleep at night knowing that our former buddies are held up in the ruins. Those poor guys... Lost, out in the wind and rain...
No! The amnesty order was a very, very wise decision!
We have news from the League camp that deserters are going back and turning themselves in! We're so pleased!
Kill 6 Bowlegged Satyrs and then speak with Crybaby the Crude.

The satyrs are the true force of evil in the forest!
Anywhere they go, they bring darkness with them. Any reasonable human should be able to see that. Or elf. Even a gibberling, if they use their head.
I want the cries of those goat-legged demons to echo throughout the forest, and for their entrails to hang from the trees like a spider's web! For their skulls to decorate the fence around my camp! And for their leader Crybaby to finally stop wailing! Do you understand? Are my orders clear? Kill six Bowlegged Satyrs, then tell their leader Crybaby to get the hell out of here! Out!
The satyr lets out a mournful sigh.
The satyr looks at you with tears welling up in its eyes.
Kill 6 Frosty Sabertooth Squirrels and bring their ears to the Skillful Family as proof.

Welcome to Maddox Depot! It's never boring around here. There are continual operations against the deserters and a huge new campaign against the satyrs. There's also another threat we're campaigning against, but nobody around here wants to listen to us!
We believe that the first priority should be getting rid of the squirrels. Oh, they're horrifying beasts! They attack our storehouses and steal our nuts. And at night they grind their teeth so loud that you can hear them in your tent... Would you please eradicate this threat?
We were on watch last night staring into the darkness when we dozed off for a bit. Then those squirrels grabbed our bowl of nuts and ran off! How long is this going to continue?!
Thank you! You're our only friend! Now we can keep watch in peace and finally get some sleep at night.
Tell Maria Trepetova about the strange incident with Crybaby the Crude.

The satyr obviously wants to tell you something. It's almost like he's begging for mercy, begging you not to kill him and his family... He hands you a small pile of nuts as a peace offering - it's all he has. A single tear slides down his cheek...
What strange behavior for a supposed spawn of the demons! Someone back at Maddox Depot should probably hear about this. Perhaps they're not the source of the darkness in the woods after all.

What? A satyr begged you not to hurt him? Have you lost your mind? Are you serving the League or not? Stop talking nonsense! If you don't want to join those rag-tag deserters, then you better march out there and fight those creatures! That's an order!
Fill the censer at the Site of Power and return to Maria Trepetova.

The camp is in an uproar! Soldiers are running off into the forest, deserting and marauding and those left in camp are drunk, rowdy, and ignoring orders. Yesterday, two drunken soldiers tried to invite me to a "party." And they didn't want to take no for an answer. I've never seen anything like this in all my many years of service!
The Church cannot ignore what is happening! I need to perform the purification ritual at once. The whole camp needs purification, not just one soldier.
I'm confident that I have the strength, but I will require assistants. Here, take this censer. It must be filled with the magic from the Site of Power - the ritual cannot work without it. Can the Church count on you?
When the censer is filled with holy magic, the ritual can begin.
Impossible! Trusty League Defenders tried to keep you from using the Site of Power? What's going on? Hurry up, let's do the ritual as quickly as possible!
Sprinkle Holy Water on the key structures of Maddox Depot for Priest Maria Trepetova.

Now I will sanctify the water by using this censer...
Finished!
Here it is! The jar of holy water. You must sprinkle it on the key structures of our camp and the Site of Power.
Our soldiers are overcome by a strange madness - please proceed as quickly as you can! And may the Light be with you!

Don't forget to go to staff headquarters, the altar, and any other places frequented by the soldiers.
Even if there aren't any demons, it won't hurt to sprinkle some holy water around...

Look at that! Will-o'-the-wisps... What does that mean? I wouldn't be surprised to find a few around a military camp, but the Site of Power? It's infected with will-o'-the-wisps?
Try to speak with Mikhail about it. Hopefully he's in a better mood and isn't screaming like a madman anymore.
Destroy 6 Damned Will-o'-the-Wisps and return to Maria Trepetova.

The soldiers tell me that there're several of these will-o'-the-wisps on the Astral shore. I've always sort of revered them since they're lost souls!
It seems that the darkness is adept at concealing itself...
The purpose of the Church is to rid the world of the darkness in whatever form it takes! Go to the shore and clear it of those cursed will-o'-the-wisps.
While you do that, I'll start looking through my library. Our books always have the answers to my questions - like ‘what's the purpose of life,' ‘can service to the Light fully compensate for lack of pleasures of the flesh,' ‘what is the justice of the Great Cataclysm' and so on... The Chronicles of the Church must have something to about the will-o'-the-wisps.
Unfortunately, my library has turned up nothing so far. But I haven't yet reached the bottom of my chest of books... What about the will-o'-the-wisps on the shore?
The will-o'-the-wisps are gone! Glory to the Light! But what did it all mean?
Find Peter Selyaninov at Zoloi Outpost.

What's happening?! It's like I've woken up from a dream... Why are you looking at me like that? Oh! I did some things... It was like I wasn't myself... Have you heard any news from Zoloi Outpost? Satyrs? What satyrs?! Zoloi Outpost is our main objective right now!
The First Tensess Chapel is a sacred place of worship for pilgrims who flock there from all over Sarnaut. There's a good reason for that, too!
You see, a League ship was once outnumbered and defeated near there by Imperial forces. Tensess' Gift already existed at the time, but few knew about it. After their heroic deaths they found themselves at this graveyard, shocked at their revival. They probably asked themselves what strange force had intervened...
At the time they could not come up with the right answer. However, because this is the first place where people were reborn with Tensess' Gift it is considered sacred by the Church.
A unit of my boys were guarding the post and protecting the pilgrims. Lately there have been all kinds of strange rumors. My nephew had just been promoted to centurion, so I sent him there to find out what's going on.
As you can see, he hasn't come back yet and I haven't heard any word from the Outpost. I'm not ordering you, I'm asking you... please go find him as soon as possible!
A young centurion's corpse... It looks like this is Mikhail Selyaninov's nephew who was sent to Zoloi Outpost...
Tell Mikhail Selyaninov about the death of Peter Selyaninov.

Unfortunately, Mikhail Selyaninov will have to be informed.
His nephew died, along with all the other guards at Zoloi Outpost.

It's no secret that life in the military isn't conducive to having kids... And I have none.
But my nephew, well, he's a real man! Peter, your uncle is proud of you! What? No! Peter and the entire unit is dead? No! Damnit! No...
Check on the Holy Spring in Tipsy Thicket for Maria Trepetova in Maddox Depot.

I heard that the outpost to the south and the First Tensess Chapel have also been engulfed by the disease... Just like our Site of Power...
Something must be done! There's another sacred place, the Source, that's south of here, in the Tipsy Thicket. It's a spring that is pure holy water. And it's all natural!
It's very dangerous to get to, but what can you do? You need to get there as quickly as possible and find out if it has been contaminated.
Oh... May the Light deliver us all!
However much we may hate our enemy, we must pray that this hasn't infected them too...

Those cursed will-o'-the-wisps are there too?!
Even sacred places cannot keep themselves free of the darkness!
What could it mean? I'll have a look though my books...
Kill Nomarkh Sekhmet near Zoloi Outpost and report back to Mikhail Selyaninov.

I missed a lot while I wasn't myself... I sent my troops to attack the satyrs and let the real threat grow! I'm so ashamed!
Okay, I'll beat myself up later... The enemy has wasted no time in taking up a key hill south of Zoloi Outpost. Our soldiers are terrified because the Imperial unit is under the command of Nomarkh Sekhmet, and Arisen that is infamous for her great brutality. They say she can't even sleep at night if she hasn't gutted someone during the day. She is courageous and her troops follow her blindly to their deaths. What a crazy and evil woman!
I'm sending you to this important position. Your objective is to fight your way through to the hill and kill Nomarkh Sekhmet, the leader of the Imperial unit. Good luck and make the League proud!
I've long dreamt of sending Nomarkh Sekhmet where she belongs – to Purgatory!
Dead? Well done! If the ground shakes during the night, don't be scared, her victims are probably dancing in their graves.
Drink the Rough Homebrew and kill 4 Imperial Mentalists outside Zoloi Outpost for Mikhail Selyaninov in Maddox Depot.

I have another mission that must be done urgently.
It's going to get hot here in Eljune soon. Imperial forces have set up long-range cannons in the Merry Forest that they'll use to attack our positions. They've also sent mentalists to the north, to the area around Zoloi Outpost. They're still zeroing in, but we've already taken losses. We must eliminate their mentalists as soon as possible! But it won't be easy - the mentalists use their mind's eye to monitor the area around them and as soon as they spot an enemy, they vanish.
There's a way of getting to them, but it involves not thinking about anything and deactivating your brain. There's a few of my boys who definitely haven't got much of a brain, but they're all so dumb that they'll never manage to complete this mission. I's much rather send you instead, but you'll have to drink a special potion before you go. It will totally shut down your conscious mind, allowing you to remain invisible to the mentalists.
Yes, unfortunately, you have to drink it... There's no other way of getting to the spotters. What's the problem? This is top rate moonshine made by the key master.
You killed the mentalists? Great! I wish all our missions were that successful, don't you?
Sprinkle Holy Water on the Site of Power near the Kotelny Camp for Maria Trepetova.

There's another Site of Power by the Imperial camp. We must make sure that it hasn't been contaminated too. You must go sprinkle holy water around it and then we'll see if any will-o'-the-wisps appear...
May the Light shine upon your path and give you its blessing! I weep for I'm afraid that I'm sending you to certain death... That Site is crawling with Imperial forces!

I found a book about will-o'-the-wisps in which Foma Morozov compares the light they emit against the true Light. His analysis is eight pages long, however it says nothing about any possible curses. What's the situation with the second Site of Power?

The Site of Power at the Kotelny Camp is also contaminated?
What are we supposed to do now?
Steal the League's Sag of Gold back from Kotelny Camp and take it to Mikhail Selyaninov in Maddox Depot.

The Empire has stolen our gold - that's obvious. I'm sorry I didn't give the order to retrieve it right away, but I was a little indisposed, as you no doubt remember!
The deserters are too weak for a mission like this - the only place they'll be able to mount a successful attack on is a brothel! The bag of gold is probably well guarded and hidden somewhere in the heart of the Kotelny Camp, the Imperial camp to the south.
Your orders are to go and get the gold back! Good luck, soldier.
Ten failed to keep the gold safe, and only one was sent to save it! That is the irony of your fate!
The gold! You managed to get it back! Justice and luck are on our side!
Free 3 captive League soldiers from the Imperial Camp for Mikhail Selyaninov.

I'm ashamed to even talk about what happened... A couple of days ago some of my boys went AWOL. The idiots felt like a trip to the brothel. They could have asked me! I would have let them go... Anyway, they didn't reach the Butterfly because they were taken prisoner by the Empire. When this was reported to me, I wasn't myself and I said something like "a dog deserves a dog's death" and "let them rot in City Council interrogation cells."
Me?! I would have never said something like that of my own free will!
Yes, going AWOL is a serious offence but I must whip them myself!
We can't leave our people in the hands of the enemy. I would be grateful if you could correct my error. The prisoners are held in the Imperial camp. Go free them!

My heart bleeds for those soldiers!
The idiots went to visit a brothel and ended up in the hands of Imperial forces. When they come back, I'll show them!

The poor bastards are free?
Well, they've got a meeting with my whip coming right up!
Take the Sack of Gold to the Peppy Family at the Eljune Bazaar.

I don't want to disappoint you, but while you were away the Secret Imperial Blueprints was stolen from our camp.
Yes, we failed to keep them safe!
But you managed to return the gold, so not all is lost! But I fear that the Imperial documents are already on their way to the auction. You must take the bag of gold to our supply officers without delay.
The League must not be outdone by the Empire!

There are rumors that the Empire has recovered their documents. How could that have happened?
What's the situation with our gold?

Our gold!
We're saved. We can scream and throw our hats in the air.
Well, we could do that, if it weren't for the "but..."
Kill 6 Imperial Soldiers in the Tipsy Thicket for Mikhail Selyaninov.

There's lots of fighting taking place in the Tipsy Thicket, in the southern part of Eljune. Our commanders are constantly requesting reinforcements. Go there and serve the League on the field of battle!
Hmm... It's not much of a field, I suppose. Just a forest with a lot of bushes and overgrown trails - it's more like guerrilla warfare than a fair fight... That's what it's come to...
How are things in the Tipsy Thicket?
Yes, it has already been reported to me. Exemplary bravery! I hear that Empire soldiers fear your name now!
Talk to the Robust Family, the League captains in the cave in Tipsy Thicket.

One of our units has performed an outstanding act of gallantry in the Tipsy Thicket.
Under the cover of darkness, the unit captured a very hard-to-reach cave. The enemy has them surrounded but they're defending it like lions.
I need you to get into that cave and any assistance that they may need. The Robust Family, a courageous group of Gibberlings, are in charge of the unit. Us men would do well to follow the examples those ladies set!

How did you manage to get in here?
...Yes, we need help badly. The enemy is destroying us and we haven't been able to get any help from outside.
Blow up three cannons in the Tipsy Thicket using Spiky Bombs for the Robust Family.

Let's get right down to business. The Empire has placed three cannons in the forest and they're using them to blow everything that's north of their camp to kingdom come! They're really making life difficult for us.
Sneaking out is getting harder and harder for us. If you could manage to get to them without being seen and kill the guards and blow up the cannons - that would be invaluable for us - we'd really owe you one. We can supply you with all the explosives you're going to need.

I don't hear the cannons anymore...
Are they taking a break or has someone finally blown them up?

The cannons are gone! That's great news!
Time for us to make our move! And it's about time, our food is running out.
Observe the forestfolk shaman and collect the three ingredients they're looking for in the Whitewood Forest for the Starry Family.

Shh... One of the forestfolk is about to pass by here... We're observing them! Isn't it interesting?
The forest people have lived on this allod for a long time in complete isolation from civilization, but as you can see, they have a proper language and social hierarchy. We believe that they also know ancient magic.
We've tried to earn their trust, especially the trust of their shamans, but unfortunately they stubbornly pretend to heal people using forest plants. We're sure that they're performing rituals in secret!
This knowledge would be very useful for the League. Unfortunately, there's a war raging and nobody cares about our research. We're having a hard time because we can't keep an eye on all the forestfolk on our own.
Their shamans are wandering the forest in search of magical ingredients at this very moment! We really need your help - six eyes, even if they're as good as ours, are just not enough.
You need to track the shamans, identify what they're collecting, and gather the same ingredients. Aren't you excited to find out the secrets of the forestfolks' ancient magic? We can't wait!
It's possible that the magic of the forestfolk originated in pre-Cataclysm times. It would be foolish not to investigate!
Wow! These specimen are so interesting! Thank you for your invaluable help on behalf of the three of us, the League, and Mother Nature. Now to figure out how they use these things... hm...
Bring Plu the Tightwad 1 Trader's Note.

Let's begin!
For starters, bring me one Trader's Note. You'll see right away how grateful I can be!
So, have you got the note?
Bring Plu the Tightwad 2 Trader's Notes.

Moving right along!
Now I want you to bring me two more notes.
Believe me, you'll like what's going to happen next!
How's it going? Got more of those notes?
Great! You're turning out to be a great friend! Now here's my end of the bargain!
Bring Plu the Tightwad 4 Trader's Notes.

I see your appetite is growing!
So is mine, yeah.
This time I need four notes. Can you handle that?
I can't wait to get those notes!

Here they are! That's it, now I've got 'em where I want 'em. I love it when people owe me, yeah...
Oh, I almost forgot - here you go!
Bring Plu the Tightwad 6 Trader's Notes.

And now, hmm...
If you want to get the best weapon I've got, bring me six more notes! Yeah!
This is turning out to be a profitable relationship, isn't it?
Don't keep me waiting! I need those notes!

Ohhh!
There are so many!
Take this, it's for you! And for me... these dirty, worthless pieces of paper, yeah!
I'm basically working at a loss, hehe!
